talk.text: Wait. Is that whole wall made of glass?
Yep! It's Villa Tugendhat in Brno, designed by Mies van der Rohe in nineteen thirty, as a family home.

label.name: Glass walls
label.meta: Glass walls that drop away to the garden

talk.text: The garden. The glass walls drop away, so the house opens straight onto it.
What's that curved bit on the terrace?
A rounded screen of glass, tucked beneath the overhang of the roof.
Even the kitchen has a view?
Yes! One big window in there looks straight out over the trees.
